desc: A kingfisher-shaped spirit: violet and pale white feathers, black void face with white eyes, long gold beak, lavender crystal crest, eerie. Cute simple pixel art pet, chunky pixels, small chibi body, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, single dark outline, flat 2-3 tone shading, limited palette of lavender, pale white, deep violet and warm gold, no halo, no sparkles, no background, no ground shadow.
